name: OPTIPRO
intro: OPTIPRO is MIRAKLE's series of ten low-voltage LED strips for coves, furniture and façades. All ten share one standard: a white 0.1 mm flexible PCB with 2.5 oz copper and CRI 90+.

name: MUSE
intro: One of the two 5 mm strips. 120 SMD 2835 LEDs per metre on a 5 mm PCB, 10 W per metre, for compact profiles and furniture.
notes: Typical applications: furniture and shelves · narrow profiles · display cases.

name: MESH
intro: The general-purpose cove strip. 168 LEDs per metre on a 10 mm PCB at 10 W per metre, for coves, recesses and indirect lighting.
notes: Typical applications: coves and recesses · linear profiles · indirect lighting.

name: HYPE
intro: High density for diffused profiles: 280 SMD 2216 LEDs per metre, an LED every 3.57 mm, at 16 W per metre, for diffused profiles.
notes: Typical applications: coves · diffused profiles · brighter linear details.

name: MOTION
intro: Tunable white from 2700K to 6500K. 192 LEDs per metre with warm and cool LEDs alternating, 20 W per metre on two channels, for spaces whose mood changes through the day.
notes: Typical applications: hospitality and residential coves · spaces that change mood through the day.

name: HAZE
intro: The 48 V cove strip. 192 LEDs per metre at 12 W per metre; the higher voltage halves the current, which suits long perimeter runs.
notes: Typical applications: 48 V linear systems · coves · long runs.

name: HYPER
intro: HAZE encapsulated to IP67: 48 V, 192 LEDs per metre, 12 W per metre, for exterior coves and façades; 48 V suits long runs.
notes: Typical applications: exterior coves and façades · 48 V for long runs · outdoor (IP67).

name: MINT
intro: A continuous line of light. A COB with 480 chips per metre under a phosphor line on an 8 mm PCB, 12 W per metre, for visible light lines and shallow profiles.
notes: Typical applications: visible light lines · shallow profiles.

name: MELO
intro: The bright 5 mm strip: 168 LEDs per metre at 15 W per metre, for furniture and task lines where the profile is narrow but the light must work.
notes: Typical applications: furniture and shelves · narrow profiles · bright task lines.

name: HEXA
intro: The highest output in the range: 240 LEDs per metre at 22 W per metre on a 10 mm PCB, for high coves, high ceilings and diffused profiles.
notes: Typical applications: high-output coves · high ceilings · diffused profiles.

name: MARINOFLEX
intro: The 24 V IP67 strip. 120 LEDs per metre on an 8 mm PCB, 12 W per metre, encapsulated for exterior coves and façades.
notes: Typical applications: exterior coves and façades · 24 V · outdoor (IP67).

name: CURVA
intro: CURVA is a 12 × 12 mm pure-silicone 3D neon band. It bends top and side, so one profile follows a three-dimensional line — up over a ceiling edge and round a wall at once. The silicone is anti-UV and anti-yellowing, and resists cold, heat and alkali, so the same reel works indoors and outdoors (IP67).
techIntro: Pure silicone, extruded square at 12 × 12 mm, with the LEDs sealed inside. The silicone is anti-UV and anti-yellowing and resists cold, heat and alkali, so colour and flexibility hold outdoors.

techIntro: A white silicone body, 16 × 16 mm, with a clear flat top. Under the top sit the optics that shape the light of the LEDs into a 35° beam for grazing a façade.

name: APOLLO
intro: APOLLO is built for large runs and demanding sites. It accepts any mains supply from 100 to 277 V AC and holds a steady 24 V output across it. A slow start protects the LEDs from inrush current, a DIP switch sets the output level on site, and the half-potted, fanless body runs silent. Efficiency is above 94% and the warranty is five years.
techIntro: 24 V constant voltage · 100–277 V AC input · IP20 · black · 5-year warranty
